string.name: settings_save_failed_toast
string.value: Could not save. Please try again.

string.name: settings_clamp_toast
string.value: The allowed limit has been reached

string.name: settings_auto_reconnect_desc
string.value: When a connection is wanted, retry after the network changes or becomes available.

string.name: settings_failover_enable_desc
string.value: In automatic selection mode, repeated failures may trigger a switch to another available node. Manually pinned nodes are not changed.

string.name: settings_failover_threshold_desc
string.value: Evaluate a failover after this many consecutive failures. Range: 1–10.

string.name: settings_failover_cooldown_desc
string.value: Minimum interval between failovers. Range: 0–3600 seconds.

string.name: settings_select_mode_auto_desc
string.value: Select a node using its status and allow failover according to policy. Sorting latency results alone does not enable automatic selection.

string.name: settings_select_mode_manual_desc
string.value: Keep your pinned node; automatic switching will not override it. Latency tests may still reorder the list.

string.name: settings_health_enable_desc
string.value: Check link health and perform bounded automatic repairs when allowed.

string.name: settings_health_repair_steps_desc
string.value: Repair limit after each health check. Range: 0–3; 0 checks without repairing.
